messages:
marta: Heads-up — running the local sampleapp with `dev-mode-backoff=fast` produced duplicate webhook deliveries to our payments staging account. Two POSTs within 200ms for the same order id.
sam: ugh. is this the same scenario as the 'no-jitter' default we saw last month? any logs?
marta: logs attached (snip):
```
2026-03-22T18:03:12.441Z ERROR retry: attempt=1 status=429 body='rate limit' order=ord_123
2026-03-22T18:03:12.643Z INFO retry: backoff=0.0ms next_attempt=immediate order=ord_123
2026-03-22T18:03:12.844Z ERROR webhook: duplicate request sent order=ord_123
```
marta: note the backoff shows 0.0ms because `dev-mode-backoff` sets jitter=0 to make loops deterministic for local debugging.
lin: ohhh that. we intentionally turn off jitter locally to make traces stable, but that obviously synchronizes retries.
jas: did the SDK attach Idempotency keys? IIRC our webhook sender only adds `Idempotency-Key` when using the `safe_replay` helper, not automatically.
sam: node-sdk in sampleapp didn't. python sampleapp did attach, which explains why Python didn't hit duplicates in staging.
lin: SDK parity gap then — node default path skips idempotency header if user enabled `dev-mode-backoff`. Bad.
marta: reproducer: run 20 parallel clients with `dev-mode-backoff=fast` and call endpoint; you'll see a wave of retries with no jitter, then 429s cascade and duplicate webhook side effects.
jas: proposal: 1) change SDK so `dev-mode-backoff` toggles only backoff timing but never disables idempotency headers; 2) add a `--preserve-jitter` flag in sampleapp to keep randomized offsets in dev; 3) add an integration test that runs local concurrency with zero-jitter to ensure dedupe still holds.
lin: +1 on parity fix. also we should update docs: warn that turning off jitter can lead to thundering herd in multi-process dev envs.
infra-bot: deploy queued for branch fix/sdk-idempotency-node -> staging at 2026-03-22T22:00:00Z :shipit:
marta: small UX note — folks debugging determinism often copy the app across machines (make a Vagrant/VM), so even 'local' runs aren't single-instance; we should default `dev-mode-backoff` to preserve tiny jitter (1-3ms) instead of 0.
sam: action items:@lin to patch node-sdk to always attach `Idempotency-Key` unless user intentionally opts out; @jas to add e2e test harness; @marta to update sampleapp flags and docs. Anyone object?
lin: I'll open the PR tonight.
jas: I'll add the test and a cron job that runs the thundering-herd sim on staging every night.
marta: thanks. leaving notes for support: "If you see duplicates after enabling dev-mode-backoff, run with `--preserve-jitter` or set `DEV_BACKOFF_MIN_JITTER_MS=2`" :warning: 
sam: good catch, thanks for the detailed repro.
deploy-bot: PR 4125 merged to staging (sdk-idempotency-node). CI: 12/12 green.
marta: marking this resolved for now, will reopen if we see further dupes in onboarding flows.
